brief: THE BET — rung 6, retire and rebuild the courtyard's population. The counts are DONE (probes/shade.mjs on HEAD, 10 seeds × summer days 5–7, warmth 0.97): the lawn's own kinds inside the wall hold a median 0.25 person at 10 h, 1.0 at 13 h, 2.0 at 16 h; at 13 h kid 0.43, napper 0.23, picnic 0.27, sitter 0, gardener 0; seed 42 at 13:25 on days 6 and 7 shows nobody. Do not re-measure — build. The cause is the iteration-1 model in the spawn loop (~line 7917): ONE `spawnAgent(room)` roll under `capacity = 2 + round(m·(3 + 9·daylight·yearBusy(EX_COURT)))` at `rate ≈ (0.05 + 0.42m)·(0.12 + daylight)`, where the default branch is a ring walker who crosses and leaves (~40 s = a resident) so `courtyardCount` is spent on transit, and the staying kinds are shares of that roll (gardener 0.10, kid 0.12, then dog/picnic/napper/sitter). The plaza (#92 spawnFamilyAgent/FAM_CAP), the cafe (#74), the warm evening (#79) each outgrew this; the courtyard is the last population still on it. Rebuild it their way: `spawnLawnAgent()` as the LAWN's own source, off `capacity`, with the lawn's PLACES as its cap — the 4 BENCH_SPOTS (sitters), shadeSpots()/napAt (nappers), the picnic annulus r 9–12 via picnicAt (pairs), the kid's run (kids, often two), EDGE_BEDS (one gardener) — each kind claiming a place at the choice and releasing it as the walk out begins; a visit priced at the choice against the retire rule (the sun ends a stay: `daylight`, SIT_REFUSE/seatRefused for the seated). Price presence as rate × visit BEFORE choosing the cap (law). Transit walkers/crossers/dogwalkers stay on the old roll under a `capacity` that no longer counts the stayers — then delete the staying branches from spawnAgent; a rebuild replaces, it does not bolt a second roll beside the first. Target: a summer 13 h holds 4–7 lawn-kind people on the MEDIAN seed (10 h ≥ 2, 16 h ≥ 3), every kind non-zero at 13 h across the sample, the lawn still empties by dark, rain and a clear winter noon stay within HEAD ± 1. A 150–300-line diff is expected and welcome; take the swing.
seams: spawnFamilyAgent (the model: FAM_CAP, famOpen, famCount, place release)
successLooksLike: probes/lawn-day.mjs (10 seeds × summer days 5–7, the shade.mjs box and kinds): median lawn-kind presence 13 h ≥ 4, 10 h ≥ 2, 16 h ≥ 3, each kind > 0 at 13 h; 0 lawn-kind stayers inside the wall at nightF > 0.5 who are not walking out; winter clear day 19 at 13 h and a rainy summer noon within HEAD ± 1; census PASS read for collapse (people will rise — say by how much; re-pin the baseline and say so), the reshuffle's ±10–19% on people is noise (census-noise.mjs); motion PASS; shots/b95-lawn-1325-s42-d6.png shows the lawn peopled where HEAD's shows nobody; wide.png at 09:00 day 4 reads busier inside the wall than shots/wide.png does now.
avoid: Do not raise `rate`/`capacity` and call it done — that puts more walkers on the ring, not people on the lawn (the counts already say the ring is busy and the lawn empty). Do not touch laneCap/eastCap/POP_FLOOR or the night floor. Do not add a sixth kind of person — the five exist; give them a source. Do not leave the old staying branches in spawnAgent alongside the new source.
